title: Health Data Analytics
outline: NAHQ CPHQ Detailed Content Outline (2024 R2b, in 2026 handbook)

questions.task_name: Identify and select measures (structure, process, outcome, experience)
questions.stem: 'Percentage of AMI patients who receive aspirin on arrival' is which type of measure?

options.A: Process
options.C: Outcome
options.D: Structure

questions.explanation_en: Process = what is DONE to or for the patient. Outcome = the result (e.g., mortality). Structure = capacity and resources.
questions.explanation_ar: نسبة من تلقوا الأسبرين مقياس عملية (Process).

questions.task_name: Identify and select measures (structure, process, outcome, experience)
questions.stem: 'The hospital has a certified stroke unit and 24/7 neurology coverage' describes which type of measure?

options.A: Outcome
options.C: Patient experience
options.D: Structure

questions.explanation_en: Structure = settings, staff, equipment, and credentials (the capacity to deliver care).
questions.explanation_ar: وجود وحدة سكتة معتمدة وتغطية أعصاب مقياس هيكلي (Structure).

questions.task_name: Identify and select measures (structure, process, outcome, experience)
questions.stem: '30-day all-cause readmission rate after heart failure discharge' is which type of measure?

options.A: Outcome
options.C: Process
options.D: Structure

questions.explanation_en: Outcome = the effect on the patient's health status or utilization. Outcomes are often risk-adjusted for fair comparison.
questions.explanation_ar: معدل إعادة الدخول خلال 30 يوماً مقياس نتيجة (Outcome).

questions.task_name: Use statistics to describe data and examine relationships (central tendency, SD, correlation, regression, t-test)
questions.stem: Patient satisfaction is rated as Very dissatisfied / Dissatisfied / Neutral / Satisfied / Very satisfied. What level of data is this?

options.A: Interval
options.C: Nominal
options.D: Ratio

questions.explanation_en: Ordinal = ordered categories with unequal or unknown spacing. Nominal = categories with no order (e.g., blood type).
questions.explanation_ar: مقياس الرضا المتدرج بيانات ترتيبية (Ordinal).

questions.task_name: Use statistics to describe data and examine relationships (central tendency, SD, correlation, regression, t-test)
questions.stem: Length-of-stay data contain several very long outlier stays. Which measure of central tendency BEST represents a typical stay?

options.A: Mode (most frequent value)
options.C: Range (maximum minus minimum)
options.D: Median

questions.explanation_en: The median resists outliers and skew. The mean is pulled toward the tail. Range is a measure of spread, not central tendency.
questions.explanation_ar: الوسيط أفضل لتمثيل البيانات الملتوية بالقيم الشاذة.

questions.task_name: Use statistics to describe data and examine relationships (central tendency, SD, correlation, regression, t-test)
questions.stem: In a normal distribution, approximately what percentage of values fall within +/-2 standard deviations of the mean?
questions.explanation_en: Empirical rule: about 68% within 1 SD, 95% within 2 SD, and 99.7% within 3 SD.
questions.explanation_ar: حوالي 95% من القيم تقع ضمن انحرافين معياريين.

questions.task_name: Use statistical process control techniques and tools (common/special cause, control charts, trend analysis)
questions.stem: Each month you plot the percentage of discharges with a completed medication reconciliation. The number of discharges varies each month. Which control chart fits?

options.A: c-chart
options.C: p-chart
options.D: X-bar and R chart

questions.explanation_en: p-chart = proportion of units with a yes/no attribute, with variable subgroup size. u-chart = rate of defects per unit of opportunity.
questions.explanation_ar: مخطط p للنسب مع اختلاف حجم العينة.

questions.task_name: Use statistical process control techniques and tools (common/special cause, control charts, trend analysis)
questions.stem: Monthly falls are reported per 1,000 patient-days, and patient-days vary each month. Which control chart fits?

options.A: u-chart
options.C: p-chart
options.D: XmR (I) chart

questions.explanation_en: Count of events (a patient can fall more than once) per variable area of opportunity = u-chart. A c-chart needs a constant area of opportunity.
questions.explanation_ar: مخطط u للأحداث لكل وحدة فرصة متغيرة.

questions.task_name: Use statistical process control techniques and tools (common/special cause, control charts, trend analysis)
questions.stem: One data point on a control chart falls above the upper control limit. What is the appropriate response?

options.A: Redesign the whole process now
options.B: Ignore it, because a single point reflects common-cause variation
options.C: Recalculate the control limits so that they include the new point
options.D: Investigate for a special (assignable) cause

questions.explanation_en: A point outside the limits signals special-cause variation, so look for the specific cause. Do not tamper with a stable process because of random noise.
questions.explanation_ar: النقطة خارج الحدود تعني سبباً خاصاً يجب التحقيق فيه.

questions.task_name: Use statistical process control techniques and tools (common/special cause, control charts, trend analysis)
questions.stem: A process is in statistical control (only common-cause variation), but its average is consistently worse than the target. What should leaders do?

options.A: Redesign the system (fundamental process change)
options.B: Do nothing, since it is stable
options.C: Investigate each high point individually to find its specific cause
options.D: Widen the control limits so that the target falls within them

questions.explanation_en: Stable does not mean good. To shift a stable process you must change the system. Reacting to individual common-cause points is tampering.
questions.explanation_ar: العملية المستقرة دون الهدف تحتاج إعادة تصميم النظام.

questions.task_name: Use statistical process control techniques and tools (common/special cause, control charts, trend analysis)
questions.stem: On a run chart, which pattern signals a shift (a non-random signal)?

options.A: Points that alternate above and below the median for several weeks
options.B: Any single point on the median
options.C: Six or more consecutive points on one side of the median
options.D: Two consecutive points above the median after a process change

questions.explanation_en: Common run-chart rules: shift = 6 or more consecutive points on one side of the median (points on the median are skipped); trend = 5 or more consecutive points going up or down.
questions.explanation_ar: ست نقاط متتالية أو أكثر في جهة واحدة من الوسيط تعني انزياحاً.

questions.task_name: Use statistics to describe data and examine relationships (central tendency, SD, correlation, regression, t-test)
questions.stem: Nurse staffing hours and patient fall rates have a correlation coefficient of r = -0.85. What is the BEST interpretation?

options.A: Increasing staffing hours causes 85% fewer patient falls on the units
options.C: Strong negative relationship; causation not proven
options.D: There is a strong positive relationship between staffing and falls

questions.explanation_en: r ranges from -1 to +1. A value of -0.85 is strong and inverse. Correlation does not equal causation, a classic trap.
questions.explanation_ar: ارتباط سلبي قوي لكنه لا يثبت السببية.

questions.task_name: Use statistics to describe data and examine relationships (central tendency, SD, correlation, regression, t-test)
questions.stem: To test whether MEAN ED wait time differs between two independent clinics, which test is MOST appropriate?

options.A: Paired t-test of the same patients
options.C: Pearson correlation coefficient
options.D: Chi-square test of proportions

questions.explanation_en: A t-test compares the means of continuous data between 2 groups. Chi-square compares categorical proportions. A paired t-test is for the same subjects measured before and after.
questions.explanation_ar: اختبار t لعينتين مستقلتين يقارن متوسطين.

questions.task_name: Use statistics to describe data and examine relationships (central tendency, SD, correlation, regression, t-test)
questions.stem: A before-and-after comparison yields p = 0.03 with alpha = 0.05. What is the correct conclusion?

options.A: The result is clinically important and should be adopted everywhere
options.B: The difference is not statistically significant at the 0.05 level
options.C: Significant; reject the null hypothesis
options.D: A 3% chance the change worked

questions.explanation_en: p < alpha means reject H0. Statistical significance does not equal clinical or practical importance.
questions.explanation_ar: قيمة p أقل من ألفا تعني دلالة إحصائية ورفض الفرضية الصفرية.

questions.task_name: Use statistics to describe data and examine relationships (central tendency, SD, correlation, regression, t-test)
questions.stem: Which analysis would predict length of stay from several variables at once (age, comorbidity score, and admission source)?

options.A: Pareto analysis of causes
options.C: Chi-square test of association
options.D: Multiple regression

questions.explanation_en: Regression models the relationship between predictor(s) and an outcome. Multiple regression uses 2 or more predictors.
questions.explanation_ar: الانحدار المتعدد يتنبأ بالنتيجة من عدة متغيرات.

questions.task_name: Use data visualization and display techniques
questions.stem: Which chart BEST shows the shape of the distribution (for example, skewed or bimodal) of ED wait times?

options.A: Histogram
options.C: Pie chart
options.D: Run chart

questions.explanation_en: A histogram uses bars of frequency by interval and shows shape, center, and spread. A run chart shows performance over time.
questions.explanation_ar: المدرج التكراري يوضح شكل توزيع البيانات.

questions.task_name: Design data collection plans: sampling methodology
questions.stem: To make sure each of five units is proportionally represented in a chart audit, which sampling method should be used?

options.A: Judgment sampling
options.C: Stratified random sampling
options.D: Systematic sampling of every 10th chart hospital-wide

questions.explanation_en: Stratified sampling divides the population into subgroups (strata) and randomly samples within each. Convenience and judgment samples are non-random and prone to bias.
questions.explanation_ar: العينة الطبقية العشوائية تضمن تمثيل كل وحدة.

questions.task_name: Collect and validate quantitative and qualitative data
questions.stem: Two abstractors independently review the same 30 charts and their results are compared. What is being assessed?

options.A: Validity of the measure definition
options.C: Risk adjustment of the outcome
options.D: Sensitivity of the screening tool

questions.explanation_en: Reliability = consistency or reproducibility. Validity = measuring what is intended. Agreement between abstractors is inter-rater reliability.
questions.explanation_ar: مقارنة مراجعَين لنفس الملفات تقيس الموثوقية بين المقيّمين.

questions.task_name: Design data collection plans: measure development (definitions, goals, thresholds, numerators, denominators)
questions.stem: For a CLABSI rate expressed per 1,000 central-line days, what is the denominator?

options.A: Number of CLABSIs
options.C: Total patient-days
options.D: Total central-line days

questions.explanation_en: Rate = (CLABSI count / central-line days) x 1,000. The denominator must reflect the population at risk (the device days).
questions.explanation_ar: مقام معدل CLABSI هو أيام القسطرة المركزية.

questions.task_name: Compare data sources to establish benchmarks
questions.stem: A quality director compares hospital mortality with a national database, but her hospital treats much sicker patients. What is needed for a fair comparison?

options.A: Using the mode instead of the mean for mortality
options.C: Removing expected deaths from the numerator
options.D: Showing the data in a larger font on the dashboard

questions.explanation_en: Benchmarking outcomes across organizations requires adjusting for patient severity and case mix, e.g., observed-to-expected (O/E) ratios.
questions.explanation_ar: المقارنة العادلة تتطلب تعديل البيانات حسب شدة الحالات.

questions.task_name: Assist in evaluating and developing data management systems to support quality improvement
questions.stem: Two departments report different fall rates for the same month from the same EHR. What is the MOST likely cause and fix?

options.A: Different definitions; build a shared data dictionary
options.B: One department is misreporting and should be disciplined for it
options.C: The EHR is broken; stop measuring
options.D: Random error; average the two numbers and report the mean rate

questions.explanation_en: A data dictionary standardizes definitions so all users get the same numbers.
questions.explanation_ar: اختلاف التعريفات يُعالج بقاموس بيانات موحد.

questions.task_name: Assist in evaluating and developing data management systems to support quality improvement
questions.stem: Which term describes the policies and accountabilities that ensure data are accurate, secure, and used appropriately across the organization?

options.A: Data mining
options.C: Data visualization
options.D: Data governance

questions.explanation_en: Data governance defines ownership, standards, quality, and access rules.
questions.explanation_ar: حوكمة البيانات تضمن دقتها وأمنها وحسن استخدامها.

questions.task_name: Assist in evaluating and developing data management systems to support quality improvement
questions.stem: The quality team is choosing between claims data and manual chart abstraction to monitor sepsis care. Which statement BEST guides the choice?

options.A: Claims: cheap and large but less clinical detail; charts: richer, costlier
options.B: Claims data always contain more clinical detail than manual chart abstraction
options.C: Both sources are identical in cost, timeliness, and level of clinical detail
options.D: Chart abstraction is always cheaper and faster than using administrative claims

questions.explanation_en: Source selection weighs cost, timeliness, and clinical detail for the measure's purpose.
questions.explanation_ar: بيانات المطالبات رخيصة لكنها أقل تفصيلاً سريرياً من مراجعة الملفات.

questions.task_name: Design data collection plans: measure development (definitions, goals, thresholds, numerators, denominators)
questions.stem: For the measure 'percentage of eligible patients receiving VTE prophylaxis within 24 hours of admission,' what is the numerator?

options.A: Eligible patients with documented contraindications to prophylaxis
options.B: All patients admitted to the hospital during the reporting month
options.C: Patients who developed a VTE
options.D: Eligible patients given prophylaxis within 24 hours

questions.explanation_en: The numerator counts patients who meet the measure criteria; the denominator is all eligible patients.
questions.explanation_ar: البسط هو المرضى المؤهلون الذين تلقوا الوقاية خلال 24 ساعة.

questions.task_name: Design data collection plans: measure development (definitions, goals, thresholds, numerators, denominators)
questions.stem: What is the difference between a target and a threshold in measure development?

options.A: They mean the same thing and can be used interchangeably in reports
options.B: Target = goal; threshold = level that triggers action
options.C: A threshold is the external benchmark from top-performing hospitals
options.D: A target is the minimum level

questions.explanation_en: Targets express aims; thresholds trigger investigation; benchmarks are external best performance.
questions.explanation_ar: الهدف هو الأداء المرغوب، والعتبة مستوى يستدعي المراجعة.

questions.task_name: Design data collection plans: measure development (definitions, goals, thresholds, numerators, denominators)
questions.stem: A hospital reports 'falls per 100 admissions,' while the benchmark uses 'falls per 1,000 patient-days.' Length of stay is longer than average. What is the BEST action?

options.A: Multiply the rate by 10
options.B: Compare the two numbers directly, since both measure inpatient falls
options.C: Recalculate with the benchmark's definition first
options.D: Drop the benchmark and compare only with the hospital's prior year

questions.explanation_en: Valid comparison requires identical numerator and denominator definitions.
questions.explanation_ar: أعد الحساب بنفس تعريف المعيار المرجعي قبل المقارنة.

questions.task_name: Design data collection plans: tools and techniques
questions.stem: Which data collection tool is BEST for real-time observation of hand hygiene on a unit?

options.A: A free-text diary kept by the unit manager during the shift
options.B: A retrospective chart review of documented hand hygiene
options.C: A standardized observation form with defined moments
options.D: A patient satisfaction survey asking about staff hand washing

questions.explanation_en: Structured observation tools with clear definitions improve consistency.
questions.explanation_ar: نموذج ملاحظة موحد بتعريفات واضحة يحسن الاتساق.

questions.task_name: Design data collection plans: tools and techniques
questions.stem: Abstractors interpret 'timely antibiotic' differently, producing inconsistent data. What is the BEST fix?

options.A: Let each abstractor decide
options.B: Stop collecting the measure because the data are inconsistent
options.C: Use only one abstractor permanently so interpretation never varies
options.D: Clear instructions with examples, retraining, and retesting

questions.explanation_en: Clear guidelines and training improve reliability; agreement should be rechecked.
questions.explanation_ar: تعليمات واضحة مع إعادة التدريب ثم قياس الاتفاق مجدداً.

questions.task_name: Design data collection plans: sampling methodology
questions.stem: Selecting every 10th discharge from a list after a random start is which sampling method?

options.A: Stratified sampling
options.C: Systematic sampling
options.D: Convenience sampling

questions.explanation_en: Systematic sampling uses a fixed interval after a random starting point.
questions.explanation_ar: اختيار كل عاشر حالة بعد بداية عشوائية عينة منتظمة.

questions.task_name: Design data collection plans: sampling methodology
questions.stem: An auditor reviews only charts that are easy to find on the unit shelf. What is the main risk?

options.A: Excessive randomness in the chart selection
options.C: A sample that is too large to review accurately
options.D: Poor inter-rater reliability between auditors

questions.explanation_en: Convenience samples are non-random and may not represent the population.
questions.explanation_ar: العينة الملائمة غير عشوائية وتسبب التحيز.

questions.task_name: Identify and select measures (structure, process, outcome, experience)
questions.stem: A team reducing ED wait times also tracks 'patients leaving against medical advice.' What type of measure is this?

options.A: Structure measure
options.B: Outcome measure of the main aim
options.C: Balancing measure
options.D: Process measure of the main aim

questions.explanation_en: Balancing measures detect unintended consequences of a change.
questions.explanation_ar: هذا مقياس توازن لرصد الآثار غير المقصودة.

questions.task_name: Collect and validate quantitative and qualitative data
questions.stem: Before presenting monthly CLABSI data, what validation step is MOST important?

options.A: Remove the highest month as an outlier before showing the trend
options.B: Check cases against definitions and line-day completeness
options.C: Present the data without checking, since it comes from the EHR
options.D: Round the numbers

questions.explanation_en: Validation confirms numerator cases and denominators are accurate and complete.
questions.explanation_ar: تحقق من الحالات وفق التعريفات واكتمال أيام القسطرة.

questions.task_name: Collect and validate quantitative and qualitative data
questions.stem: Which method is BEST for collecting qualitative data about why patients feel discharge instructions are confusing?

options.A: Claims data review of readmissions
options.C: Control charts of complaint counts
options.D: Patient interviews or focus groups

questions.explanation_en: Qualitative methods capture reasons and experiences in patients' own words.
questions.explanation_ar: المقابلات ومجموعات النقاش تجمع بيانات نوعية عن الأسباب.

questions.task_name: Identify external data sources for comparison and benchmarking
questions.stem: Which is an example of an external data source for comparing hospital infection rates?

options.A: Unit huddle notes from infection meetings
options.C: Employee time cards and staffing reports
options.D: The hospital's own incident reporting system

questions.explanation_en: NHSN provides national comparative data for HAIs.
questions.explanation_ar: شبكة NHSN مصدر خارجي لمقارنة معدلات العدوى.

questions.task_name: Identify external data sources for comparison and benchmarking
questions.stem: A hospital wants to compare its patient-experience scores with peers. Which external source fits BEST?

options.A: The hospital's Facebook page reviews
options.C: Internal comment cards from inpatient units
options.D: Publicly reported HCAHPS results

questions.explanation_en: Standardized, publicly reported surveys allow valid external comparison.
questions.explanation_ar: نتائج HCAHPS المنشورة تسمح بالمقارنة الخارجية.

questions.task_name: Design scorecards and dashboards for different audiences
questions.stem: What should a board-level quality scorecard MOSTLY contain?

options.A: Every measure collected anywhere in the hospital each month
options.C: Daily unit staffing grids and overtime hours for all departments
options.D: A few strategic measures with trends and targets

questions.explanation_en: Boards need concise, strategic, trended information.
questions.explanation_ar: بطاقة المجلس تحتوي مقاييس استراتيجية قليلة مع الاتجاهات والأهداف.

questions.task_name: Design scorecards and dashboards for different audiences
questions.stem: Which statement BEST distinguishes a dashboard from a scorecard?

options.A: They are identical tools that simply use different color schemes
options.B: Dashboard: real-time operations; scorecard: periodic strategic targets
options.C: A dashboard never uses graphs, while a scorecard always uses charts
options.D: A scorecard is always real-time, while a dashboard is updated yearly

questions.explanation_en: Dashboards support operations; scorecards support strategic review.
questions.explanation_ar: لوحة المعلومات تشغيلية آنية، وبطاقة الأداء استراتيجية دورية.

questions.task_name: Design scorecards and dashboards for different audiences
questions.stem: A unit dashboard uses red/green colors based on a single month versus target, causing managers to react to every red month. What is the BEST redesign?

options.A: Trend the data with SPC limits to separate signal from noise
options.B: Remove all targets so managers stop reacting to the red months
options.C: Show only the green months so that the units are not discouraged
options.D: Use brighter colors so the red months stand out more clearly

questions.explanation_en: Single-point red/green displays encourage tampering; trends with limits support good decisions.
questions.explanation_ar: اعرض الاتجاه الزمني مع حدود التحكم للتمييز بين الإشارة والضجيج.

questions.task_name: Use data management systems for organization, analysis, and reporting of data
questions.stem: A quality analyst needs to combine lab results, medication data, and admissions to report sepsis outcomes monthly. What is MOST efficient?

options.A: A data warehouse query linking sources in a standard report
options.C: Ask nurses to tally sepsis cases by hand at the end of every shift
options.D: Manually copy data from each separate system into a spreadsheet

questions.explanation_en: Integrated data systems enable reliable, repeatable reporting.
questions.explanation_ar: مستودع البيانات يربط المصادر ويُنتج تقريراً قياسياً.

questions.task_name: Use data management systems for organization, analysis, and reporting of data
questions.stem: Which action protects patient privacy when using data management systems for QI analysis?

options.A: Storing analysis files on personal USB drives
options.C: Emailing full patient records to all team members
options.D: Sharing one login password among the analyst team

questions.explanation_en: Access controls and minimum necessary use protect PHI.
questions.explanation_ar: صلاحيات حسب الدور والحد الأدنى من البيانات تحمي الخصوصية.

questions.task_name: Use data visualization and display techniques
questions.stem: Leaders want to see which of 10 complaint categories account for most complaints. Which display is BEST?

options.A: Run chart
options.C: Pareto chart
options.D: Scatter diagram

questions.explanation_en: Pareto charts rank categories and show cumulative percentage.
questions.explanation_ar: مخطط باريتو يرتب الفئات حسب تكرارها.

questions.task_name: Use data visualization and display techniques
questions.stem: Which display BEST shows monthly CLABSI rates over two years for a unit?

options.A: Bar chart of the most recent month
options.B: Pie chart of infections by device type
options.C: Pareto chart of infections by organism
options.D: Run chart or control chart

questions.explanation_en: Time-ordered displays show trends and variation.
questions.explanation_ar: مخطط التشغيل أو التحكم يعرض البيانات عبر الزمن.

questions.task_name: Use measurement tools to evaluate process improvement
questions.stem: A team tests a new triage process. Which approach BEST shows whether the change led to improvement?

options.A: Compare one day before and after
options.B: Count the number of triage redesign meetings that were held
options.C: Ask the ED staff whether the new process feels any faster
options.D: Annotated run chart of door-to-provider time

questions.explanation_en: Annotated run charts show whether changes coincide with non-random shifts.
questions.explanation_ar: مخطط التشغيل مع توضيح بداية التغيير يبين أثره.

questions.task_name: Use measurement tools to evaluate process improvement
questions.stem: After a change, a run chart shows 7 consecutive points below the median for a measure where lower is better. What is the BEST interpretation?

options.A: A data error that should be corrected
options.B: Deterioration in performance after the change
options.C: A shift showing non-random improvement
options.D: Random variation that needs no further attention

questions.explanation_en: Six or more consecutive points on one side of the median indicate a shift.
questions.explanation_ar: سبع نقاط متتالية تحت الوسيط تعني انزياحاً يدل على تحسن.

questions.task_name: Use measurement tools to evaluate process improvement
questions.stem: Which set of measures does the Model for Improvement recommend for evaluating change?

options.A: Only outcome measures tied to the aim
options.C: Only patient satisfaction and experience measures
options.D: Only cost and financial return measures

questions.explanation_en: Using all three gives a complete picture of the effect of the change.
questions.explanation_ar: مقاييس النتيجة والعملية والتوازن معاً.

questions.task_name: Compare data sources to establish benchmarks
questions.stem: A hospital's observed/expected (O/E) mortality ratio is 1.25. What does this mean?

options.A: The data are invalid because O/E cannot exceed 1
options.B: Mortality is 25% lower than expected for its patient mix
options.C: Mortality is 25% higher than expected
options.D: Mortality equals the expected rate after risk adjustment

questions.explanation_en: O/E above 1 for an adverse outcome indicates worse-than-expected performance.
questions.explanation_ar: نسبة O/E أعلى من 1 تعني وفيات أكثر من المتوقع بـ 25%.

questions.task_name: Compare data sources to establish benchmarks
questions.stem: Which comparison is an internal benchmark?

options.A: Comparing the hospital's own units
options.B: Comparing results with a published clinical trial
options.C: Comparing with a hospital in another country
options.D: Comparing with NHSN national comparative data

questions.explanation_en: Internal benchmarking compares units or sites within the same organization.
questions.explanation_ar: المقارنة بين وحدات المستشفى نفسها مقارنة داخلية.

questions.task_name: Interpret data to support decision-making
questions.stem: A medication-error control chart shows all points within limits, with no patterns, and the mean is at target. A manager wants to retrain staff after one high month. What is the BEST advice?

options.A: Don't react to one common-cause point; keep monitoring
options.C: Retrain all nursing staff immediately on medication safety
options.D: Recalculate the control limits so that they exclude the high month

questions.explanation_en: Reacting to common-cause variation (tampering) increases variation.
questions.explanation_ar: لا تتفاعل مع نقطة ضمن الحدود؛ استمر في المراقبة.

questions.task_name: Interpret data to support decision-making
questions.stem: A new protocol lowered LOS by 0.1 day with p = 0.01 in a sample of 20,000 patients. How should leaders interpret this?

options.A: Not statistically significant at the 0.05 level
options.B: Significant, but may not be practically meaningful
options.C: Highly important clinically and should be adopted everywhere
options.D: Proof that the protocol caused the reduction in length of stay

questions.explanation_en: Large samples make tiny differences significant; judge practical importance too.
